persona: Reconcile downstream conditional R4 contract to CP revision4; source only
scope: Security-owned source contract authoring only, parallel to independent serializer tests. No code or execution.
exportPolicy: Only whole schema-valid objects; bounded U+2026 previews are excluded by multiple truncated fields or an exact summary-prefix continuation in another whole candidate. Every whole candidate is preserved; no partial content exported.
providerMetadataQualification: topLevelProviderMetadata contains only provider-envelope system/init/result fields. Recursive actualProviderMetadata may include names in quoted source/tool results and is not sufficient by itself for identity qualification.
rateLimitDiagnosticScope: Only top-level event counts and allowlisted rate_limit_info.status enum values; no provider text, partial output or private details.
